description: This file defines the NewtonsoftJsonCodec class, which implements JSON serialization, deserialization, and copying functionalities for the Orleans framework using Newtonsoft.Json. It includes methods for writing and reading serialized data, deep copying objects, and determining supported types, with specific focus on JSON token types and custom type filtering.

classes.name: NewtonsoftJsonCodec
classes.description: A codec class for serializing, deserializing, and copying objects using Newtonsoft.Json within the Orleans framework. Implements interfaces for general encoding, copying, and type filtering.

methods.name: NewtonsoftJsonCodec
methods.description: Constructor initializing the codec with type selectors and options, setting up the JSON serializer.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes an object field into the writer, including type information and JSON payload.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes a value from the reader, reconstructing the object based on stored type info.

methods.name: IsSupportedType
methods.description: Determines if a type is supported for serialization or copying, including native JSON token types.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of an object via JSON serialization and deserialization.

methods.name: IsSupportedType (private)
methods.description: Checks if a type is supported for serialization or copying, considering framework types and custom selectors.

methods.name: ThrowTypeFieldMissing
methods.description: Throws an exception if the serialized type information is missing.

methods.name: IsNativelySupportedType
methods.description: Checks if a type is a native JSON token type supported by Newtonsoft.Json.
